name: 33185 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33185 (Miami) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33185 (Miami) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
69% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33185 (Miami) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 74% of all organizations here have no identified type.
